objective: Introduce a survey-neutral, explicit light-curve normalization contract and align product documentation without changing the frozen scientific model baseline.
previous_knowledge_consumed: The product roadmap requires separation of import support, analysis support, model compatibility, and scientific validation.
PR #212 introduces explicit source-column mapping and declared time/measurement semantics; it does not implement end-to-end external survey adapters or establish cross-survey model performance.
The v0.2.0 42-feature contract and v1.0.1 release artifacts must remain unchanged.

baseline.description: Main branch and published release v1.0.1; frozen scientific baseline v0.2.0.

expected_improvement: Preserve source-row identity, order, duplicate observations, missing numeric values, units, time semantics, and declared measurement type during normalization.
Reject ambiguous or malformed mappings without silently converting units, flux/magnitude, or time systems.
Add regression coverage for reordered/renamed columns, missing values, malformed inputs, duplicate observations, and no implicit conversions.
Keep import normalization distinct from model compatibility and scientific validation.
Provide a local CSV/Parquet file-loading entry point that retains leading-zero identifiers, row order, missing numeric values, and file-format provenance.
Add a TESS Transients text adapter that preserves the documented BTJD/TDB semantics, selected source measurement, and e_mag=99.9 upper-limit marker without implicit calibration.
Add an explicit-column FITS reader for TESS/TGLC-like table products and regression tests for source-value/row preservation.
Audit a public ZTF DR17 flare-event catalogue, preserve event multiplicity, and provide a reproducible local catalogue audit command.
Maintain a public multi-survey test matrix that distinguishes synthetic format tests from real-source import verification and scientific model validation.

correctness.before: The first CI run for PR #212 failed Ruff lint with four findings in lightcurve_schema.py.
correctness.after: Latest-head workflows are queued/in progress after adding the TESS text adapter, explicit-schema FITS reader, event-catalogue audit utility, tests, and source matrix. No latest-head pass is claimed yet.
correctness.evidence: Latest branch head before this cycle update: 5ff95bd5a0dab996f3571e5292f46a6bb6b175a9. CI runs 40013095773 and 40013088299 are pending; Scientific Validation 40013095379, Product Scope Audit 40013095370, and CodeQL 40013095442 are in progress.

evidence: No model, feature schema, class order, training data, production thresholds, or scientific acceptance criteria were changed.
TESS Transients and FITS adapters currently have synthetic regression fixtures only; live source-file retrieval, checksums, and source row-count reconciliation remain pending.

A bounded inspection of public SNAD flare-catalogue CSV content at source commit 9a132ad9ac20df1d7a4b08ea36547271c9eff05e found 1,234 event rows and 1,227 unique object IDs; seven objects each have two events. This is an event catalogue, not a per-observation light curve.

Catalogue missingness and class counts are recorded in configs/datasets/snad_ztf_dr17_m_dwarf_flares_catalog.json. The source file Git blob SHA is recorded; SHA-256 of a locally retrieved file has not yet been computed.
Latest-head CI/security/scientific workflows must finish and be inspected before this PR is considered validated.

root_causes: The earlier CI run failed Ruff import ordering in the local CSV/Parquet loader; an import-order correction was committed, but the latest-head CI result is still pending.

A synthetic test fixture is not evidence of a real external source file being retrieved or reconciled; the external data validation workflow must explicitly separate format tests from source-backed verification.
failure_analysis.impact: No release or main-branch change was made. New adapters remain proposed on an open draft PR. Live TESS/TGLC import and model scientific compatibility are not established.
failure_analysis.correction: Add TESS text and explicit FITS ingestion with regression tests, record a bounded public ZTF flare-event catalogue audit, add a repeatable event-catalogue audit utility, and keep source-backed retrieval and scientific validation explicitly pending.

findings: Every meaningful implementation change requires a lifecycle record in the same pull request.
Schema normalization must preserve explicit units and time semantics and must not silently imply model compatibility.
CI success is not scientific acceptance; source-backed cross-survey inference remains unimplemented and unvalidated.
Survey-neutral ingestion requires format-specific parsers where source formats differ; FITS is not a CSV variant.
Event catalogues require event-level row accounting: repeated object IDs may indicate multiple real events rather than duplicate observation rows.
Public source-backed experiments must pin the repository revision, source file identity, schema, row accounting, missingness, and file hash before results are considered reproducible.

open_blockers: Run latest-head Ruff format/lint, full test suite, lifecycle gate, runtime smoke tests, package build, and dependency audit.
Retrieve a pinned real TESS Transients text file and a TGLC/TESS FITS file; record SHA-256, source schema, row/object counts, and reconciliation evidence.
Implement a source-appropriate analysis workflow for the ZTF flare event catalogue; do not treat event rows as light-curve observation rows.
Fix StarEmbed object-level split/duplicate leakage before reporting any benchmark score.
Scientific validity and cross-survey model compatibility remain NOT_MEASURED.

knowledge_carried_forward: Keep the v0.2.0 baseline and v1.0.1 release immutable.
Do not claim end-to-end multi-survey support or cross-survey model performance from schema normalization alone.
Keep CPVS exact reconstruction unresolved until its published-method semantics are supported by evidence.
TESS Transients format adapter: synthetic tests exist, but live-file retrieval and source reconciliation are still required.
Generic explicit-schema FITS reader: synthetic TESS-like FITS fixture exists, but actual TGLC/TESS file compatibility is unverified.
SNAD flare catalog audit: source revision 9a132ad9ac20df1d7a4b08ea36547271c9eff05e; 1,234 event rows; 1,227 unique object IDs; seven two-event objects; do not deduplicate by oid.
